Why (simulator, measurement only): the slot is a precision gate - only a skim through the shelf's ~80 u slit at shelf height with >= ~1,000 u/s toward it passes (45/9,600 bench flights; 0/132,840 from the line's own positions at 0.6-2.5x its speed); the explore step itself from the line's last 2.5 s puts 1 of 90,000 bursts in the slit at shelf height (at 189 u/s) and passes none; a cross-entropy search over the same actions (1.15M rollouts) from the line's last 4 s never reaches it either.
Lesson: a uniform explore step rooted on the policy's own line clears the walls the potential field shows (4 ON TIME, CP2 1.8x ahead of October) but not a hidden precision gate whose entry has to change seconds upstream.
Next (generic, untested): search over the approach itself (macro actions, the planner's commitment, an objective that scores the conjunction); and the PPO ratio is decided by the Gaussian view heads (>= 99% of the per-step KL; approx_kl median 4.0 at 14B).
